body_html:
When a training room has to become a meeting space by lunch and clear out by five, this 48" x 24" flip-top table earns its keep. A single lever drops the laminate top flat so the table rolls away and nests against the next one — adding just 5.25" to the stack — then locks securely back into place when it's time to work. It's a practical, mobile foundation for rooms that never sit still.

Features

  • Single-lever flip-top mechanism with integrated dual side-locking in the use position
  • Flips flat and nests for compact storage and rapid room turnover
  • Four locking casters for safe mobility and stable positioning
  • Integral modesty panel built into powder-coated steel Y-legs (Tungsten finish)
  • 1" thermally fused laminate top, shown in Asian Night
  • ANSI/BIFMA Level and GREENGUARD Gold certified — proudly made in Canada

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 48"W x 24"D x 29.5"H with a 1" top, weighing 61.9 lbs. Built by Global Furniture Group under the Offices To Go Newland line and ships easy-to-assemble in three cartons.
